title: Conversations with Richard Fidler and Sarah Kanowski - ABC listen
description: Conversations draws you deeper into the life story of someone you may, or may not, have heard about — someone who has seen and done amazing things.

episodes.title: Radio National: Ron McCallum's story of 'being born blind at the right time'
episodes.description: Law professor Ron McCallum was a premature baby, and the treatment he received as a newborn in the 1940s left him totally blind. At the time, expectations for his future were low.

episodes.title: Holiday Listening: Nerida's nudibranchs, sea dragons and siphonophores
episodes.description: As a marine molecular biologist, Dr Nerida Wilson spends a lot of her time getting acquainted with the mysterious creatures lurking in the dark depths of the sea.

episodes.title: Radio National: How Brolga became a 'Kangaroo Mum'
episodes.description: Chris ‘Brolga’ Barns knew early on he wanted to make a living working with animals. When he grew up he became a kangaroo rescue specialist

episodes.title: Holiday Listening: Lee Berger, the real-life Indiana Jones, and the Case of the Lost Hominids
episodes.description: When Lee Berger entered the field of palaeoanthropology there was a one in 10,000,000 chance he would discover anything 'worthwhile' digging around South Africa. But this real-life Indiana Jones kept bucking the odds.

episodes.title: Radio National: Stan Grant on his lessons from his father
episodes.description: Journalist and writer Stan Grant on his remarkable life, and the lessons he learned from his father

episodes.title: Holiday Listening: Fishing for feelings -- the many ways fish are smarter than you think
episodes.description: Dr Culum Brown is a leading researcher in the field of fish cognition, his research has shown that even that smallest fish are capable of learning and can retain memories for months.

episodes.title: Radio National: Kirsty De Vallance on surviving and thriving after her father's arrest
episodes.description: When Kirsty de Vallance was 16 her father, then a senior customs officer, was convicted and imprisoned for heroin trafficking.

episodes.title: Holiday Listening: The flying vet from Outback Queensland
episodes.description: Dr Campbell Costello's work as a vet has taken him out of his family's station in North Queensland to places as far flung as Kazakhstan, Mongolia and Patagonia.

episodes.title: Radio National: Christian the male midwife working in Arnhem Land
episodes.description: Growing up south of Sydney as one of six boys, midwifery wasn't the occupation Christian Wright expected for himself. At the age of nine, he experienced a vision that gave him a sense of his future in a life of service.

episodes.title: Holiday Listening: Slime moulds—the brainless blobs that can move and solve mazes
episodes.description: Dr Tanya Latty is an insect scientist with a quirky taste in pets, and a keen eye for detail, but it's the lessons from her brainless pet slime mould that she's most fascinated about.
